verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair axis for an AI app builder, but the evidence does not show a product feature for user-defined automations that run on a schedule or trigger. Build mode runs a single requested task end to end, which is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule. Scheduled Deep scans cover only security scanning, and edge functions are developer building blocks, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
